ActorTalk: The Starwhisper Project? I remember that from tech history class!
From the name alone, it sounds like a space broadcast system.
Exactly! It converted people's recorded well-wishes into electromagnetic signals and sent them to satellites so they could play them out in space.
After the Punishing outbreak, the satellites lost contact with the ground. They stopped receiving new messages from Earth, but they never stopped broadcasting the ones they already had.
Writers love using these signals as story hooks now. Horror stories, romances, everything.
I even have a few books about them. The newest one is Confessions Adrift in the Starry Sea. If you want to read it, I can bring it right now... actually no, we should finish the mission first. Hehe.
Forget the messages for a moment. I keep thinking about how we could bring those satellites back. If they're still running after all these years, they must be worth salvaging.
If we recover them, we might find useful research material too.
I'll keep an eye out for that during the next tests.
Perfect. I traced the signal again, and it leads to airspace AR003. This part is up to you, [PlayerName].
